title: OpenMods support for one harness
description: mods/<owner>/<name>/<harness>/support.json: the mod's versions on this harness, one per harness release it has worked on, each with its patches.

versions.description: Newest first. CI adds a version when the newest one still applies and typechecks on a newer release; older versions stay, so mods that move at different speeds can still be built together at a release they all have.

ref.description: The harness release tag these patches are for, e.g. v1.18.32.

patches.description: Applied in order with git am, from a folder named after the release tag, e.g. v1.18.32/0001-add-tetris.patch.

update.description: Which update of the mod's code this version holds. open-mods pack sets it: one more than the latest when the changed lines differ, the same when only rebased onto another release. CI keeps it when it adds a version for a new release.

note.description: One line on what this update changed, from open-mods pack --note. Users see it when they are offered the update.

conflicts.description: Mods, as owner/name, that break this one on this harness without changing the same lines. Mods that change the same lines are found automatically.
